Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: original e-commerce gift catalog photography, image only, not a UI
Primary request: photograph a ready-made "Little Pause" gift set opened on an ivory tabletop. A rigid rectangular pale blush gift box with its lid set beside it, exactly one speckled ivory ceramic mug (no saucer), one small closed plain sage green linen notebook and one slim brass ballpoint pen. Three products in total nestled in off-white shredded paper; show all three completely.
Style: premium but approachable realistic studio product photography, tactile paper and ceramic, soft natural side light, no excessive styling.
Composition: landscape 4:3, top-down three-quarter camera, entire box, detached lid, all three contents fully visible and legible as objects, room around edges for crop. Warm ivory background, dusty rose box, muted sage notebook, subtle natural shadows.
Constraints: no words, no lettering, no logos, no gift message or card, no food, no candle, no extra products, no people, no text, no watermark. This is original fictional product imagery.
